rule: MTP step = the composed step (token_path_export) + every critical charge; overlapped charges carry their proof

charges.element: adopted NREG controller transition between successive MTP passes
charges.formula: +1 per steady-state MTP pass after the first; single-pass/EOS/prefill cases add 0
charges.variant: adopted NREG=1; step throughput conservatively charges the recurring transition

charges.element: hfd_mtp die master pin flops (command -> engine done round trips)
charges.formula: 7 dependent round trips a step (5 draft-head commands, verify, accept/emit) x 2 (+1 per pin crossing)
source: results/rtl/hbm_mtp_20261008/bench/round1.json cycle_note (+1 per pin crossing, +2 per round trip)
charges.variant: x-stop (die-router selections) live; hfd_mtp_x_lvt would be +4 a round trip (PRL 2)

charges.element: hfd_mtp logit-row input pin flop + am output (6 argmax streams)
charges.formula: (5 draft heads + 1 verify) x (lg_* in +1, am_* out +1)
+1 per argmax stream x 6 (rows stream; the register adds latency once a stream)

charges.element: router topK (topk_f384) on every MoE layer of the verify walk
charges.formula: 40 MoE layers (du:router_top6 on the verify path) x +1 a select

charges.element: spec-state window gathers through hfd_mtp (sr/sa valid-ready streams)
charges.formula: 3 DSpark stages' window-row gather streams x +3 (once a stream: valid/ready ports behind skid slices accept one request a cycle)
charges.note: the bench issues gathers serially (+3 each, upper bound); on the die each stream pays the latency once

charges.element: spec_state_f answer latency on the accept path

charges.formula: +2 capture -> write (fence_p), once a step before the next step's reads
charges.variant: fence_p charged (+2); the banked -cx (mtp_fence_b64-*-75cb677e4, 0 cycles) is routing: 0 if it closes

charges.formula: commit outputs registered 1 cycle after acc_done
40 layers x up to 6 accepted positions = 240 KV rows x +3
charges.variant: adopted mtprb-dskvwb_spec_p2a-5ce6c3c62-tc; wrapper pin FIFO costs retained
charges.overlap_proof: the accepted rows of step s are written while step s+1 drafts: the draft phase (54,336 cycles) runs on the DSpark stages' own state (main_x + their wkv window rows), and the first read of a main-model KV row is verify layer 0 after the draft; the +3/row adds <= 720 cycles to a write stream that must fit in 54,336 cycles

basis_note.note: The HBM native and approved gather paths are distinct; systems.json uses ds_sw_seq_pricing.json approved_path_c2_g22 and adds its delta relative to native S2 once per verify pass. These component charges carry over to either basis unchanged.
